# Try Precision recall with new pipeline
```{bash}
# uv run eris -i ../data/EC958_complete_genome.fasta -d ../data/IS_n.mmi -o ../progress/result/new_pipeline_block -m collapse
```


```{python}
# Precision and recall
import importlib
import matrix as mt
importlib.reload(mt)
import pandas as pd

# Ground truth 
gt = mt.format_gt(mt.GT)

# New dataframe
fa_new = mt.format_fa("../result/fa_22_9/fa_22_9_report.tsv", "INSIDE")

summary, df = mt.precision_recall(gt, fa_new, 0)
print(summary)

# Convert df 
df.to_csv("../result/fa_22_9/precision_recall.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

# Convert to bed so I can view it in IGV
fa_bed = fa_new[["transcript", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "repeats"]]
fa_bed.to_csv("../result/fa_22_9/new_pipeline.bed", sep="\t", index=False)
```

New pipeline block
```{python}
fa_block= mt.format_fa("../result/new_pipeline_block/new_pipeline_block_report.tsv", "INSIDE")

summary_block, df_block = mt.precision_recall(gt, fa_block, 0)
print(summary_block)

df_block.to_csv("../result/new_pipeline_block/precision_recall.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

fa_bed = fa_block[["transcript", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "repeats"]]
```
